name: Bizmark
long_description: Bizmark agents do the daily management work in factories. Think OpenClaw for manufacturing. Bizmark agents learn how each factory is managed, then automate the daily work. They learn from the results to make better decisions over time. Founders are cousins Rodrigo (grew up in a factory; CS & MBA at UChicago; built a distribution business 0→$60M) and Oscar (Engineering, Stanford; deployed AI for the US Air Force and machine learning at Amazon, Johnson & Johnson, and Intel). There’s a quarter of a million manufacturers in the US, making this a $25B market. In 5 years, we’ll make all of these factories manage themselves.
